scripts.build:editor: pnpm run build:protocol && pnpm --filter @jot-md/editor run build
scripts.demo:dev: pnpm run build:protocol && pnpm run wasm:demo && vite --config apps/demo/vite.config.mjs
scripts.demo:build: pnpm run build:protocol && pnpm run wasm:demo && tsc -p apps/demo/tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build --config apps/demo/vite.config.mjs
scripts.benchmark:build: pnpm run build:protocol && node scripts/build/build-wasm.mjs benchmarks/src/generated && tsc -p benchmarks/tsconfig.json && vite build --config benchmarks/vite.config.mjs
scripts.test:ts: pnpm run check:architecture && pnpm run build:protocol && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/checks/run-typescript-tests.mjs
